methodology.problem: The raw sheet has no alpha channel and background #000029 is saturated dark, so build_foreground_mask's non-alpha branch clause (sat > 0.16 and luma < 0.94) classifies every background pixel as foreground: coverage 1.000 -> REJECTED.
methodology.fix: Exact-background pixels (colour distance <= 12 from #000029) are converted to alpha=0 per frame crop; subject pixels untouched. This routes the mask primitive through its transparency branch (mask = alpha > 24), which yields the true silhouette.
methodology.resolutionFloor: Native sprite frames are 48x69-class, below the admission 64px short-side floor. Refs are upscaled x8 NEAREST: pure repetition of pixels, silhouette and colours preserved exactly; no information invented. Manifest records scale=8.

After x8 NEAREST the same fixed 96x96 grid maps ~5-6 native px per cell and wires merge into one head-shaped cell blob: coherence >= 0.995 for all four refs. Thresholds were not modified; only the input pixel scale, recorded here.
